title: Tourist Season, 2006 · the board
logline: Two days after: the tourist has posted the drawing online, and the chorus has grown, and Wood at the garage's computer reads the thread with the dog's chin on his knee. The strip draws the screen as a rectangle of gray with stick figures climbing out of it.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at a beige computer, the screen a gray rectangle. BARNABY's chin on his knee.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man at a beige desktop computer with a gray screen and a dog's chin resting on his knee

panels.composition: The screen: gray, and stick figures climbing out over its bottom edge onto the desk.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a computer monitor drawn as a gray rectangle with tiny stick figures climbing out over its bottom edge onto a desk

panels.composition: The chorus on the desk around the mouse, arguing in tiny balloons the strip doesn't letter.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, tiny stick figures gathered around a computer mouse holding tiny empty speech balloons

panels.composition: WOOD switching the monitor off. The chorus left on the desk in the dark, one still talking.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man switching off a monitor while tiny stick figures remain on the desk in the dark

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: Seed of Message Boards (Sept). The chorus stays on the desk.
